title: Connect published Foundry research to a canonical human and machine front door
summary: User-requested integration of the completed industry and valuation research into the existing Library, preserving source ownership and project-scoped material.
intent: Make reviewed Foundry outputs discoverable and reusable through stable Library links and exact source versions.
reasoning: Foundry owns the research source; the Library already owns stable identity, release selection and generated readers.
A generated index and machine-readable dossier let projects find the same source without creating competing canonical copies.
Private project packets keep their existing access boundaries.

changes.summary: Reserve generated research readers and existing home/Foundry links.

evidence.summary: All 17 published N1 records were read back publicly and match reviewed source hashes.

next_actions: Publish reviewed value-model source, register the exact Foundry Release in a successor Snapshot and build human/machine readers.
Verify canonical links, source parity, display behavior and the deployed stable URLs.
